verdict.rationale: TrueLayer's Data API says it provides access to identity data alongside accounts, transactions and balances for all integrated banks (docs-28). The Verification API compares identity data against the account holder's name on connected accounts (docs-29, docs-3), which directly supports matching the account owner to a customer. Name-based screening against bank records is also documented (docs-9). missing for 10: an explicit list of returned identity fields showing addresses, phone and email are included; independent or hands-on corroboration.
